key_insight: A scenario-free bilevel optimization framework coordinates EV charging and reactive power support using DLMPs to reduce cost while improving voltage security under uncertain load and PV output.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a computationally efficient way to integrate flexible EV demand, voltage regulation, and uncertainty handling in distribution-grid operation.
method: Upper-level EV aggregator schedules active and reactive charging power to minimize charging cost.
Lower-level EMS solves network-constrained economic dispatch and sets DLMPs under feeder and voltage constraints.
A robust counterpart reformulation handles asymmetric net-demand uncertainty without large scenario sets.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation on the IEEE 33-bus distribution system, showing improved voltage security, effective uncertainty-aware coordination, and lower computational complexity versus conventional stochastic and robust methods.
watch_item: The KKT/Big-M reformulation and exactness assumptions may be sensitive to parameter tuning and real-world operational constraints.
paper_title: Scenario-Free Uncertainty-Aware DLMP-Based Bilevel Coordination of EV Charging and Reactive Power Support in Distribution Networks
